findings: Original paintings, native 1672 by 941 composition and four-row plate sheet inspected. Limestone towers, foliage and the flat central stone runway have coherent material and upper-left light; the stands remain open.

FAR is a high vista over a deep valley rather than the requested low eye level. MID foliage at both outer edges contains small missing islands and pink remnants. NEAR introduces a clearly visible horizontal texture and focus transition near the lower sixth, especially on the left.
The terrain is mechanically continuous, but perspective, fringe/island repair and combatant contrast remain visual holds. No native motion, parallax or acceptance is claimed.
